rows.14:b9cc: I wrenched my neck around and looked back over my shoulder. The doll with the split head was strangling {f:me|me}.{p}
rows.14:b574:
"My contract is hereby concluded."
The instant the voice spoke, the principal screamed.{p}
rows.14:b79c:
Then, in an instant, he was nothing but skin and bones, and he crumbled.
He hit the floor and shattered, and not even a corpse was left, only a heap of sand.
...The contract is over?
The contract with the devil{f:?|?}{p}
rows.14:c4a4:
No one would believe {f:my|my} story anyway{f:.|.}
I'd like to run this as the seventh story in the school paper's special feature{f:, but|, but}... come to think of it, that project has been stalled ever since that day.{p}
